description: This file is a JUnit test class for the PatientIdentifierValidator in the OpenMRS project. It contains unit tests verifying the validation logic of patient identifiers, including format checks, uniqueness, and length constraints, using Mockito for mocking and assertions for validation.

classes.name: PatientIdentifierValidatorTest
classes.description: Test class for validating the functionality of PatientIdentifierValidator, extending BaseContextSensitiveTest for context-aware testing.

methods.name: validateIdentifier_shouldFailValidationIfPatientIdentifierIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validateIdentifier throws BlankIdentifierException if the PatientIdentifier argument is null.

methods.name: validateIdentifier_shouldPassValidationIfPatientIdentifierIsVoided
methods.description: Ensures that a voided PatientIdentifier passes validation without exceptions.

methods.name: validateIdentifier_shouldFailValidationIfAnotherPatientHasAMatchingIdentifierOfTheSameType
methods.description: Checks that a duplicate identifier of the same type triggers an IdentifierNotUniqueException.

methods.name: validateIdentifier_shouldFailValidationIfPatientIdentifierTypeIsNull
methods.description: Verifies that a null PatientIdentifierType leads to a BlankIdentifierException.

methods.name: checkIdentifierAgainstFormat_shouldFailValidationIfIdentifierIsBlank
methods.description: Ensures that an empty identifier string throws a BlankIdentifierException.

methods.name: checkIdentifierAgainstFormat_shouldFailValidationIfIdentifierDoesNotMatchTheFormat
methods.description: Asserts that identifiers not matching the regex format throw an InvalidIdentifierFormatException.

methods.name: checkIdentifierAgainstFormat_shouldPassValidationIfIdentifierMatchesTheFormat
methods.description: Confirms that identifiers matching the regex format pass without exceptions.

methods.name: checkIdentifierAgainstFormat_shouldPassValidationIfTheFormatIsBlank
methods.description: Verifies that an empty format string results in no validation exception, accepting all identifiers.

methods.name: checkIdentifierAgainstValidator_shouldFailValidationIfIdentifierIsBlank
methods.description: Tests that a blank identifier triggers a BlankIdentifierException when validated with a specific validator.

methods.name: checkIdentifierAgainstValidator_shouldFailValidationIfIdentifierIsInvalid
methods.description: Confirms that an invalid identifier according to the validator throws an InvalidCheckDigitException.

methods.name: checkIdentifierAgainstValidator_shouldPassValidationIfIdentifierIsValid
methods.description: Verifies that a valid identifier passes validation with the given validator.

methods.name: checkIdentifierAgainstValidator_shouldPassValidationIfValidatorIsNull
methods.description: Ensures that passing null as validator skips validation and does not throw exceptions.

methods.name: validateIdentifier_shouldFailValidationIfIdentifierIsBlank
methods.description: Validates that blank identifier in a PatientIdentifier object throws a BlankIdentifierException.

methods.name: validateIdentifier_shouldPassIfInUseAndIdTypeUniquenessIsSetToNonUnique
methods.description: Checks that identifiers in use with non-unique type do not cause validation errors.

methods.name: validateIdentifier_shouldPassIfLocationBehaviorIsNotUsedAndLocationIsNull
methods.description: Verifies that when the location behavior is 'not used,' a null location does not trigger an error.

methods.name: validateIdentifier_shouldPassIfLocationBehaviorIsRequiredAndLocationIsNull
methods.description: Ensures that when location behavior is 'required,' a null location causes a validation exception.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Tests that identifiers with correct length pass validation successfully.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Checks that overly long identifier or void reason fields trigger validation errors.

methods.name: checkIdentifierAgainstFormat_shouldIncludeFormatInErrorMessageIfNoFormatDescriptionIsSpecified
methods.description: Verifies that the error message includes the format regex when no description is provided.

methods.name: checkIdentifierAgainstFormat_shouldIncludeFormatDescriptionInErrorMessageIfSpecified
methods.description: Checks that the error message contains the custom format description when provided.
